CROSS-REFERENCE.

SUBJECT:-

The following note is taken from S.I.S. note on different individuals engaged in anti Nazi activities.

Karl Groehl.

Nominally independent, but cooperates with Karl Otten and J.F. Glas in London and with Munzenberg in Paris. Has contacts in Amsterdam and Sweden. Groehl, Otten and Glas are in direct touch with Wickham Steed.

NB. see also chart at end of this report.

Original in.............................................dated.......................

S. Form 81.
